tara: Quick alignment thread: we need final decisions on (1) export bundle schema and (2) BYOK escrow consent flows before next pilot kickoff. Short replies please. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ben: Export bundle = ndjson for items + manifest.json + signed_manifest.sig. Manifest must include export_id, tenant_id, export_ts_iso, item_count, total_bytes, retention_tier, legal_hold, signer_id, signer_cert_version, and per-item sha256.

harpreet: Security: escrow must be opt-in. Two modes: NO_ESCROW (platform never keeps a copy) and TEMP_ESCROW (timebound HSM unwrap for export). TEMP_ESCROW requires signed consent and audit trail.

nina: Ops: auto-export on key-destroy only if TEMP_ESCROW is enabled. Cap auto-export to 200GB, otherwise route to manual export queue with SLA 72h. Notify tenant at 72/24/6h before destroy.

tara: Good. How long do we keep escrow key material? Suggest max 7 days and auto-delete after export window. Harpreet?

harpreet: 7 days seems fine. Require two-person approval for any manual unwrap outside automated flow. All unwraps logged and certificate attached.

ben: Add acceptance tests: replay key-destroy event -> produce bundle -> validate manifest + signature -> verify hashes. Include edge case where key is missing -> mark items unrecoverable in manifest.

nina: Pilot constraints: Dedicated/private only for first 2 customers. Metrics: export_success_rate >= 99%, p95_export_time <= 12h for <=200GB, unrecoverable_flag_rate < 0.1%. Ops runbook must include manual export steps and legal escalation.

tara: Product UX: consent checkbox with clear copy: "Allow Redwood to escrow a time-limited decryption key to enable export if you rotate or destroy customer-managed keys. You can withdraw consent; withdrawing before a destroy cancels exports." I'll draft copy.

ops-bot: Note: maintenance window 1769994000 UTC. Avoid running large export jobs during that time.

harpreet: Security/Compliance mapping: this touches SOC2 CC6 (data lifecycle) and CC7 (access controls). We'll include control IDs in PR.

tara: Action items: ben -> manifest + sample bundle; harpreet -> HSM escrow spec and approval guardrails; nina -> runbook + metrics + pilot checklist; tara -> product copy + contract clause. Target PR by EOW. :white_check_mark:
